mcqs.question: What was India's total rooftop solar capacity in 2025?
mcqs.explanation: India's total rooftop solar capacity reached 20.8 GW in 2025. The 7.1 GW figure refers to the capacity added during the year, while 19.45 lakh refers to systems installed under PM Surya Ghar.

mcqs.question: Which scheme placed India among the largest new carbon markets highlighted in the World Bank's State and Trends of Carbon Pricing 2026 report?
mcqs.explanation: The World Bank report identified India's Carbon Credit Trading Scheme (2026) as placing the country among the largest new carbon markets. PM Surya Ghar concerns rooftop solar, the Paris Agreement is an international climate agreement, and Utility-Led Aggregation concerns rooftop-solar installations.
